what_this_is: Quantity-only design side of the runs that change the facility inventory and move event dates (E4(a) slow path, E4(b) anchoring off, the later-start sensitivity on outcomes at +1, +3 and +5 years, and E7's redraw of permit-dated start years), for the headline set at 2%. Each host's event year is its first crossing on the alternative inventory; comparison eligibility is re-read there; then G-a rematches at the new reference year. Timing sensitivity with rematching, not an isolated timing effect. PROVISIONAL: the design stands as of 2026-11-18, the plan is a draft and not frozen, and E7's error distribution is fixed at the freeze. No price, revenue or bill is read.

E7_every_cohort_utility.seed_and_draw_streams: Seed 20261203 (E7_SEED) and the streams exactly as e7_starts builds them. Draw i uses numpy's generator keyed by (E7_SEED, i) over the redrawn rows of e7_rows in their order, which do not depend on the set. So draw i redraws the inventory identically for every set, and only the set's hosts, reference design and roster differ. The agent's reading (session 25, 2026-11-20), since the existing functions give no other stream for a second set without a new rule.
